Source: https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/legal/changelogs.html

# Notas de lançamento

Alterações técnicas que afetam os produtos, serviços ou a API pública da AIVAX. As datas indicam quando as entradas foram adicionadas ou atualizadas, não sendo datas confirmadas de implantação em produção. Cada item identifica o produto ou serviço afetado; a manutenção sem efeito visível ao usuário é omitida.

## Sexta-feira, 30 de outubro de 2026

Alterações:

- **AI Gateways — Modo de moderação.** Os parâmetros do gateway da IA aceitam `moderationParameters.mode`, com `LayeredGuardrail` (o padrão e o comportamento anterior) e `SelfAssessment`. `LayeredGuardrail` analisa o texto de entrada da conversa com um modelo de salvaguarda independente antes do modelo principal e bloqueia conversas sinalizadas. `SelfAssessment` não executa uma chamada de moderação separada, portanto, não há cobrança por análise de moderação: o modelo principal recebe instruções de moderação construídas a partir dos mesmos níveis de sensibilidade das categorias e regras adicionais, além de uma ferramenta de recusa interna, e encerra a inferência com uma recusa quando a solicitação mais recente atinge o limite de uma categoria habilitada. Requer um modelo que suporte chamadas de ferramentas e troca menor latência e custo por um julgamento que não é independente do modelo principal. A seção Moderação de Conteúdo do editor do gateway da IA inclui um seletor **Modo de moderação**, e o resumo do pipeline do gateway mostra o modo ativo quando a moderação está habilitada. Consulte [Pipeline de processamento](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/pipelines.md#moderation).
- **Painel — Opções de prompt de configuração do agente.** O botão **Copiar Prompt** na página inicial abre um menu com dois prompts de configuração para agentes de codificação: **Agente MCP + Habilidades**, que configura o MCP de gerenciamento de conta e as habilidades do agente AIVAX, e **Agente CLI**, que instala a [CLI AIVAX](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/cli.md) e vincula a conta como um perfil de CLI. O endpoint `GET /api/v1/accounts/agent-setup-prompt` aceita um parâmetro de consulta `type` opcional (`mcp`, o padrão, ou `cli`).
- **CLI — Fazer login com uma chave de API.** `aivax auth login --api-key <API_KEY>` vincula um perfil de conta usando uma chave de API existente, sem a chave de login da conta ou código autenticador. Consulte [Ferramenta CLI](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/cli.md#install).
- **Contas — Obter a conta autenticada.** O novo endpoint `GET /api/v1/accounts` retorna o identificador, o nome de exibição e o e-mail da conta que possui a chave de API.
- **Conversas — Acompanhar conversas em andamento.** O novo stream de Eventos Enviados pelo Servidor (SSE) `GET /api/v1/conversations/management/live` envia o status das conversas sendo geradas na conta: origem, modelo, tempo decorrido, uso parcial de tokens e pré-visualizações de entrada e saída. Uma conversa concluída permanece no stream por 10 segundos com status `completed` e o `conversationId` armazenado, que é `null` quando a conversa não foi armazenada. `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>` também aceita o identificador ao vivo e retorna as mensagens atuais, e `GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/sse` transmite elas até o fim da conversa. Apenas conversas que seriam armazenadas são rastreadas, portanto, solicitações com registro de conversa desabilitado não aparecem. Chamadas de ferramentas do lado do servidor só são mostradas após o armazenamento da conversa. Na página **Conversas**, as conversas em andamento aparecem acima da lista armazenada e a lista é atualizada quando elas terminam; abrir uma delas a acompanha ao vivo e muda para a conversa armazenada quando ela é salva.

## Quinta-feira, 29 de outubro de 2026

Correções:

- **Conta — Adicionando o primeiro autenticador.** Confirmar o primeiro autenticador não falha mais com um erro de propriedade obrigatória. O código do autenticador atual só é necessário quando a conta já possui um.

Alterações:

- **Conta — Diálogo de autenticação de dois fatores compacto.** O diálogo de autenticação de dois fatores na aba **Segurança** é mais estreito. Ao adicionar um autenticador, o código QR é mostrado ao lado do segredo, seguido pelos campos de nome e código de seis dígitos. O diálogo fecha pelo seu cabeçalho e **Cancelar** retorna à lista de autenticadores.

## Wednesday, October 28th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Language models — Special providers require opt-in.** Integrated text models no longer route to special discounted providers by default. Requests for a model that is currently available only through special providers fail unless they use the new `Special` routing preference, or the account enables **Allow special providers** and uses a preference other than `Balanced`. See [Special providers](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/inference.md#special-providers).

Alterações:

- **Conta — Permitir provedores especiais.** As configurações de privacidade da conta incluem **Permitir provedores especiais**, desativado por padrão. Quando habilitado, as preferências de roteamento `Cheapest`, `Fastest` e `Quality` também consideram provedores especiais, que servem modelos a preços descontados sob condições que podem ser menos transparentes. `Balanced` nunca os usa.
- **Modelos de linguagem — Preferência de roteamento `Special`.** AI Gateways (`parameters.routingOption`) e `routing_options.preset` aceitam `Special`, que funciona como `Balanced`, mas também inclui provedores especiais e lhes dá prioridade, independentemente da configuração da conta.

## Tuesday, October 27th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Language models — Models removed and router alias updated.** `@arcee-ai/trinity-large-thinking` is no longer in the model catalog; requests that name it are rejected. `@poolside/laguna-xs-2.1` and `@poolside/laguna-s-2.1` are removed; both were already deprecated and their provider endpoints expire on October 31, 2026. `@model-router/openai:mid` now selects `@openai/gpt-6.1-terra` instead of `@openai/gpt-6.1-sol`.
- **Decisions — Decider V1.1 removed and aliases retargeted.** `@perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` is no longer in the decisions catalog; requests that name it are rejected. `@perplexity/pplx-decider` now resolves to `@perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2` instead of Decider V1.1, and `@liquid/d` now resolves to `@liquid/d1.1` instead of `@liquid/d1`. The replacements keep the same $0.02 per million input tokens price.

Alterações:

- **RAG — Filtrar documentos por referência.** Os filtros de documentos aceitam o campo `reference` com `=`, `!=`, `in`, `contains`, `startswith` e `endswith`, por exemplo `reference = "manual-v2"` para selecionar cada chunk de uma fonte. Documentos sem uma referência nunca correspondem a uma condição positiva nela e correspondem a `reference != "..."`. Anteriormente, `reference` era rejeitado como um campo desconhecido. Isso se aplica onde os filtros são aceitos, incluindo pesquisa, navegação e ferramentas MCP de Coleções. Consulte [Filtros de documentos](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/document-filters.md#fields).
- **MCP — Ferramentas de navegação e obtenção de documentos do Collections MCP.** O Collections MCP agora expõe duas ferramentas além da busca semântica. A ferramenta de navegação (`{collection_name}_browse_documents`, ou `{collection_name}_list` com a convenção de nomenclatura `agent`) lista documentos indexados com um filtro de documento opcional, ordenação por criação, atualização ou data de indexação, ou nome, paginação por cursor, e retorna nomes, tags e datas, com conteúdo apenas quando solicitado. A ferramenta obter documento (`{collection_name}_get_document`, ou `{collection_name}_get`) lê um documento por seu nome exato, opcionalmente por intervalo de linhas, incluindo documentos ainda aguardando indexação. Nenhum tem custo de busca; ambos contam para o limite de taxa de busca. Clientes que se conectam ao Collections MCP veem duas ferramentas a mais; use `X-Mcp-Enabled-Tools` para ocultá-las. Consulte [Coleções e RAG MCP](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/mcp-utilities/collections-mcp.md#generated-tools).
- **MCP — Escolher quais ferramentas do Collections MCP são expostas.** O Collections MCP aceita o cabeçalho opcional `X-Mcp-Enabled-Tools` com uma lista separada por vírgulas de `search`, `browse`, `get`, `write` e `delete`, para que um cliente possa, por exemplo, adicionar e pesquisar documentos sem poder excluí-los. `write` e `delete` ainda exigem `X-Mcp-Allow-Write: yes`. Sem o cabeçalho, todas as ferramentas permitidas pelos outros cabeçalhos são expostas. Consulte [Coleções e RAG MCP](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/mcp-utilities/collections-mcp.md#select-which-tools-are-exposed).
- **Modelos de linguagem — Novos modelos.** Adicionado `@openai/gpt-6.1-terra`, o modelo GPT-6.1 de nível intermediário ($1,10 por milhão de tokens de entrada, $5,50 por milhão de tokens de saída, contexto de 1,05M de tokens), e `@reflection/beam-1.0-501b-a23b`, o modelo de raciocínio de peso aberto da Reflection ($0,40 por milhão de tokens de entrada, $1,20 por milhão de tokens de saída, contexto de 1M de tokens).
- **Modelos de linguagem — Esforços de raciocínio GLM.** `@z-ai/glm-5.2`, `@z-ai/glm-5.1` e `@z-ai/glm-5` agora aceitam os níveis de esforço de raciocínio `max` e `high`, correspondendo à documentação do provedor.
- **Geração de imagens — Qwen Image 2.1 Pro.** Adicionado `qwen-image-2.1-pro`, incluindo imagens de referência, com um custo estimado de $0,04 por imagem de saída.
- **Fala para texto — Novos modelos de transcrição.** Adicionado Mistral's Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 ($0,004 por minuto) e Voxtral Mini Transcribe 3 ($0,0035 por minuto) ao catálogo de transcrição.
- **Texto para fala — Novos modelos de síntese.** Adicionado ElevenLabs V4 ($0,08 por 1.000 caracteres) e V4 Turbo ($0,04), Mistral Voxtral Mini TTS 3 ($0,013), HeyGen Voice 1 Turbo ($0,004) e Voice 1 ($0,015), e Fish Audio S2.1 Pro ($0,015) como fontes de síntese de áudio em gateways da IA e clientes de chat.
- **RAG — Novos rerankers.** Adicionado `@jina/reranker-v3.5` e `@nvidia/nemotron-3.5-rerank-8b` ($0,05 por milhão de tokens de entrada) ao catálogo de rerankers.
- **Decisões — Novo modelo de decisão.** Adicionado `@liquid/d1.1` ($0,02 por milhão de tokens de entrada, sem cobrança de saída), aceitando texto com um contexto de 64K.
- **Modelos de linguagem — Provedores agrupados por tier de roteamento.** O diálogo de detalhes do modelo na página Modelos do painel agrupa provedores nas seções Default, Flex, Priority e Special quando um modelo oferece mais de um tier.

## Monday, October 26th, 2026

Alterações:

- **Modelos de linguagem — Mais modelos listam seus esforços de raciocínio.** `modelInformation.reasoningEfforts` em `GET /api/v1/information/models.json`, e o diálogo de detalhes do modelo na página Modelos do painel, agora listam os níveis aceitos para `@qwen/qwen3.8-max`, `@qwen/qwen3.8-flash`, `@qwen/qwen3.8-omni-flash`, `@anthropic/claude-4.5-opus`, `@openai/o3`, `@openai/o3-mini`, `@openai/o4-mini`, `@google/gemini-2.5-pro`, `@google/gemini-2.5-flash`, `@google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, `@bytedance/seed-2.1-turbo` e `@nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl`. Solicitações e gateways permanecem inalterados.
- **Processamento de dados — Novo endpoint de Extração.** `POST /api/v1/generations/extract` lê textos, documentos JPEG, PNG, TIFF e PDF e retorna um objeto JSON por documento, moldado pelo `responseSchema` obrigatório, na ordem de entrada. Cada propriedade do esquema é um campo para encontrar, e sua descrição é o critério de busca; `$ref` e `$defs` não são suportados. Imagens e arquivos aceitam URLs de dados base64 ou URLs públicos. URLs públicos são baixados até 5 MB, URLs de dados base64 são limitados apenas pelo tamanho da solicitação, e outros tipos de conteúdo são rejeitados. Apenas tokens de entrada são cobrados, a $0,04 por milhão. Você também pode executá-lo na aba Extração na página Gerações do painel. Consulte [Extração](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/extraction.md).
- **Processamento de dados — Novo endpoint de Resumo.** `POST /api/v1/generations/summarize` aceita os mesmos tipos de documento e retorna uma string de resumo por documento, opcionalmente guiada por `instructions`. Apenas tokens de entrada são cobrados, a $0,04 por milhão. Extração e Resumo compartilham um limite por documento de 10 por minuto e 300 por dia no Free, 200 por minuto no Pro, e 2.500 por minuto no Max. Você também pode executá-lo na aba Resumo na página Gerações do painel. Consulte [Resumo](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/summarization.md).
- **Processamento de dados — Novo endpoint de Traduções.** `POST /api/v1/generations/translate` traduz texto, o texto visível em imagens e a fala em áudio para qualquer `toLanguage`, e retorna uma string traduzida por documento, na ordem de entrada. `fromLanguage` é opcional e é detectado a partir do conteúdo quando omitido. O uso é cobrado em unidades de processamento. Os limites são 30 solicitações por minuto e 300 por dia no Free, 200 por minuto no Pro, e 2.500 por minuto no Max. Você também pode executá-lo na aba Tradução na página Gerações do painel. Consulte [Traduções](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/translations.md).
- **Processamento de dados — Orientação mais clara entre Extração, Fetch e Descrições de Mídia.** As páginas Descrições de Mídia e Fetch e OCR agora explicam quando usar cada serviço. Consulte [Extração, Fetch ou Descrições de Mídia](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/extraction.md#extraction-fetch-or-media-descriptions).
- **Conta — Autenticação de dois fatores e recuperação de login no console.** A página **Minha conta** do console tem uma aba **Segurança**. Os titulares da conta podem adicionar um ou mais aplicativos autenticadores; o código QR e o segredo são mostrados apenas até que o código de seis dígitos seja confirmado, e o login pede um código apenas depois que pelo menos um autenticador é confirmado. Mudar para uma conta salva pede o mesmo código quando essa conta tem autenticação de dois fatores. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` aceita `totpCode` e retorna `requiresTwoFactor` em vez de uma sessão quando o código ainda é necessário. Contas sem um autenticador permanecem inalteradas, e as chaves de API não são afetadas. A página de login vincula ao suporte da conta, onde **Recuperar chave de login** envia um link de login único válido por uma hora e um link de redefinição de chave de login após pedir o e-mail de registro. A confirmação é a mesma independentemente de esse e-mail pertencer a uma conta. O link de redefinição, e **Redefinir chave de login** em **Segurança**, criam uma nova chave de login, enviam-na por e-mail e desconectam a conta de todos os sessões do console. Eles não revogam chaves de API nem desabilitam a autenticação de dois fatores. Desabilitar a autenticação de dois fatores sem um código de autenticador atual é tratado pelo [Suporte AIVAX](https://aivax.net/contact/). Consulte [Login no console](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/authentication.md#console-sign-in).

## Sunday, October 25th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Language models — MiniMax router alias now selects M3.1 Flash.** `@model-router/minimax:latest` now selects `@minimax/m3.1-flash` instead of `@minimax/m3`. The new model accepts text, images, and video, improves agentic, coding, and cybersecurity results over M3, and its current OpenRouter list price is $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens, lower than M3. Call `@minimax/m3` directly to keep using the previous model.

Alterações:

- **RAG — Novos endpoints de pesquisa.** Adicionado `POST /api/v2/query` (Consultar coleções), `POST /api/v2/query/similar` (Encontrar documentos semelhantes) e `POST /api/v2/query/browse` (Navegar por documentos). As consultas agora retornam resultados paginados com um pool de candidatos reutilizável, pontuações separadas de similaridade, reranking e final, ordenação por pontuação, criação, atualização ou data de indexação, ou nome, e filtros por coleção. Páginas posteriores de uma consulta não são cobradas novamente; um cursor de Consultar coleções permanece válido por 10 minutos após seu último uso, e um cursor expirado retorna `410 Gone`, então repita a solicitação sem um cursor. Encontrar documentos semelhantes pesquisa pelo vetor armazenado de um documento indexado, e Navegar por documentos lista documentos indexados por data de criação, mais antigos primeiro por padrão, opcionalmente filtrados; nenhum tem custo de embedding ou reranking. Enviar um `reranker` junto com uma classificação diferente de pontuação é rejeitado; sem um `reranker`, o reranker padrão é ignorado para essas classificações. Todos os três endpoints também estão disponíveis no host direto. Consulte [Pesquisa](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/semantic-search.md).
- **RAG — Endpoint de pesquisa anterior descontinuado.** `POST /api/v1/query` continua funcionando para integrações existentes, mas está descontinuado. Para migrar, envie `terms` para `POST /api/v2/query`, substitua `top` por `limit` (se você omiti-lo, `limit` assume o padrão 10, enquanto `top` assumia o padrão 5, e o reranker pontua `limit` × 3 candidatos, então defina `limit` explicitamente para manter o mesmo custo por consulta) e `includeReferences` com `"include": ["content", "metadata", "references"]`, e leia os resultados de `data.results[].document` e `data.results[].scores`. Solicitações sem termos de pesquisa vão para `POST /api/v2/query/browse`, que, diferentemente do endpoint anterior que retornava os documentos mais recentes primeiro, retorna os documentos mais antigos primeiro, a menos que `sort` esteja definido. `POST /api/v1/answer` não está descontinuado.

## Friday, October 23rd, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Language models — Router aliases now select newer models.** `@model-router/kimi:latest` now selects `@moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro` instead of `@moonshotai/kimi-k3`. The new model accepts text, images, and video. Its price in the AIVAX catalog is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, lower than Kimi K3 ($3 and $15). `@model-router/mercury:latest` now selects `@inception/mercury-3` instead of `@inception/mercury-2.5`. `@model-router/pareto:latest` now selects `@unbiased/pareto-26.10` instead of `@unbiased/pareto-26.9`. Pareto 26.10 does not accept structured output; keep calling `@unbiased/pareto-26.9` when a request needs `response_format`. The previous models remain available under their own identifiers.
- **Image generation — Amazon Nova Canvas removed.** `nova-canvas` is no longer in the image catalog. An image API request that names it is rejected, and saving a gateway that still stores that name fails validation. If a gateway already stores it, the chat image tool falls back to the default image model, FLUX Schnell (`flux-schnell`). Choose another listed image model if that fallback is not suitable.

Correções:

- **Language models — Retired Xiaomi endpoints are no longer selected.** The deprecated models `@xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` and `@xiaomi/mimo-v2.5-pro` no longer route to Xiaomi's direct API, which shut down on October 21, 2026. Requests use the remaining providers. Both models stay deprecated.

Alterações:

- **Modelos de linguagem — Novos modelos e entrada de vídeo.** Adicionado `@moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro`, `@minimax/m3.1-flash`, `@inception/mercury-3` e `@unbiased/pareto-26.10`. `@moonshotai/kimi-k3` agora aceita vídeo, bem como texto e imagens.
- **Modelos de linguagem — Preço de entrada em cache no Groq.** Tokens de entrada em cache para `@openai/gpt-oss-20b` no Groq agora são cobrados a $0,037 por milhão de tokens. Antes desta alteração, eram cobrados ao preço regular de entrada de $0,075 por milhão.
- **Geração de imagens — FLUX.3 Image Klein.** Adicionado `flux-3-image-klein`, incluindo imagens de referência, com um custo estimado de $0,019 por imagem de saída para o tamanho padrão do provedor.
- **Decisões — Novos modelos de decisão de texto.** Adicionado `@perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2` ($0,02 por milhão de tokens de entrada), `@perplexity/pplx-decider-flash-v1.2` ($0,01), `@nace-ai/drex-max` ($0,06), `@respan/span-02` ($0,01) e `@liquid/d1-ultra` ($0,042). `@typesafe/jev` agora resolve para JEV 1.14 em vez de 1.13 ao mesmo preço, e novos aliases foram adicionados para os modelos de decisão Perplexity, Nace, Respan e Liquid.

## Monday, October 19th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Gateways — One time zone per gateway.** AI Gateways now have a `timeZone` parameter (IANA identifier, default `America/Sao_Paulo`) used for every date the model reads or writes: `get_date_time`, scheduling tools, and the bash environment. It replaces `builtinFunctionsOptions.dateTimeTimeZone` (previous default `America/Los_Angeles`) and `bashOptions.timeZone` (previous default `UTC`), which are no longer read. Gateways and Batch workflows that relied on the old defaults now report São Paulo time; set `timeZone` on the gateway to keep another zone. In `/v1/chat/completions`, send `time_zone` instead of `builtin_tools.options.dateTimeTimeZone` to override the zone for one request. In the dashboard, the setting moved to **Date and time** in the gateway's **Parameters + Tuning** tab and was removed from Batch tool options. See [Current Date and Time](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/builtin-tools.md#current-date-and-time).

Correções:

- **Chat clients — Scheduled messages no longer run alongside a reply.** In Telegram and WhatsApp integrations, a scheduled message that becomes due while the assistant is still answering the same conversation now waits for that answer to finish instead of running a second reply in parallel. Messages received during a reply also wait and are answered afterwards. Previously, both runs could act on the same conversation, and one reply could be dropped from its history. A delayed scheduled message is still sent if the conversation becomes free within 30 minutes of its scheduled time.

Alterações:

- **Chat clients — Scheduling uses the gateway time zone.** `schedule_assistant_message` now reads times without a UTC offset in the gateway time zone, `create_recurring_job` evaluates cron expressions in that zone, and `list_scheduled_jobs` returns scheduled times in it. They previously used the server time zone. Times with an explicit UTC offset keep their exact instant. `get_date_time` is now always available alongside the scheduling tools. Set the gateway `timeZone` to your users' time zone so reminders fire at the expected local time. See [Current Date and Time](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/builtin-tools.md#current-date-and-time).

## Sunday, October 18th, 2026

Alterações:

- **RAG — Mais detalhes na lista de documentos da coleção.** A tabela de documentos de uma coleção agora mostra a data de criação, a última data de atualização e a contagem aproximada de tokens de cada documento, e rola horizontalmente quando as colunas não se encaixam. Linhas com mais de três tags mostram as três primeiras e um badge **+N more**; passe o mouse sobre ele para ver as tags restantes. `GET /api/v1/collections/{collection-id}/documents` agora também retorna `createdAt` e `approximateTokenCount` para cada documento. Consulte [Coleções](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/documents.md).
- **RAG — Documentos formatados no playground de pesquisa.** O playground de pesquisa da coleção renderiza o conteúdo dos documentos retornados e referenciados como Markdown, no mesmo layout usado pelas mensagens de conversa, e adiciona um botão **Read docs** ao lado de **View code** que abre a [documentação de busca semântica](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/semantic-search.md).
- **Conta — Badge de plano personalizado.** Contas em um plano Personalizado agora mostram um badge de plano com o mesmo tamanho e estilo dos badges Free, Pro e Max.

## Saturday, October 17th, 2026

Alterações:

- **Batch — Roteamento otimizado por custo para fluxos de trabalho que não usam um AI Gateway.** Fluxos de trabalho que processam itens com um modelo integrado em vez de um AI Gateway agora sempre usam a preferência de roteamento `Cheapest`, selecionando o provedor disponível com o menor preço de token de entrada e saída para esse modelo. O padrão `Balanced` não se aplica mais neste caso, então os itens podem rotear para um provedor diferente do que antes. Para manter a preferência padrão ou escolher `Fastest` ou `Quality`, use um AI Gateway com essa preferência de roteamento no fluxo de trabalho. Consulte [Batch](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/batch.md#model-and-routing).

## Friday, October 16th, 2026

Correções:

- **Gateways — Blocked `read_skill` calls keep the active skill.** When a gateway hides tools without a skill, a `read_skill` call blocked by a gateway worker or rejected as invalid no longer removes the tools of the skill activated by the previous successful call. Only successful `read_skill` calls change the active skills. See [Skills](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/skills.md#structure-and-operation).
- **Built-in tools — Current date and time returns JSON.** `get_date_time` now returns the documented JSON object with `date`, `time`, `day_of_week`, `time_zone`, `utc_offset`, and `date_time` fields. It previously returned a text summary with a different layout. Instructions or workers that parse the previous text should read these fields instead. See [Current Date and Time](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/builtin-tools.md#current-date-and-time).

Alterações:

- **Account — Self-service Pro and Max subscriptions.** The **My account** page now shows the subscription state under the current plan and offers **Subscribe to plan** on Free accounts, **Cancel subscription** and **Change plan** on paid accounts, and **Resubscribe** while a cancellation is pending. Plan selection shows Pro and Max side by side with their monthly price, main resources, and the amount due today or the date a downgrade starts. Plans are purchased for the calendar month: a first purchase or upgrade is charged now for the remaining days of the month, minus the unused part of what was already paid for the current month, and applies as soon as the payment is confirmed; a downgrade or cancellation takes effect at the next renewal on the first day of the month. Renewals are charged automatically on the first day of each month using the saved payment method; while a renewal is unpaid, a reminder is sent every two days until the tenth day, after which the account returns to Free. Custom plans are managed by the AIVAX team and cannot be changed from the page. The same operations are available through `GET /api/v1/subscriptions`, `POST /api/v1/subscriptions/plan`, `POST /api/v1/subscriptions/cancel`, and `POST /api/v1/subscriptions/resubscribe`. See [subscription pricing](https://aivax.net/pricing) and [Plans and limits](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/limits.md).
- **Account — Saved payment methods.** Paid accounts can open **Payment methods** from the **My account** page to add, remove, or set the default card used for automatic renewals, or list them through `GET /api/v1/subscriptions/payment-methods`.
- **Account — Credits and subscriptions are paid through Mixtic.** The **Add credits** dialog no longer asks for a payment method: credit purchases and subscription charges use Mixtic payment links or the saved payment method, and the fees shown before payment reflect this provider. `POST /api/v1/payments` and `GET /api/v1/payments` now ignore the `method` field and query parameter; unknown methods are no longer rejected. Unpaid invoices created in the last 24 hours are also checked with Mixtic every few minutes, so a paid invoice is confirmed even when the payment notification does not arrive.
- **Analytics — Invoice type, payment link, and receipt.** The **Invoices** tab now shows whether each invoice is a credit purchase or a subscription payment, a **Pay** link while an invoice is open and not expired, and a **Receipt** link once it is paid. `GET /api/v1/information/balance` returns the same data in the `type`, `paymentLocation`, and `receiptLocation` fields of each invoice. Unpaid subscription invoices are removed when they expire and can no longer be paid.

## Wednesday, October 14th, 2026

Correções:

- **Gateways — Skill tools visible when tools without a skill are hidden.** When a gateway hides tools without a skill, the tools listed in a skill's `allowedToolsNames` now become available after the model activates that skill with `read_skill`. Previously, only the always-visible tools and `read_skill` were offered. Only the skills from the most recent successful `read_skill` call count as active, so a call blocked by a gateway worker or rejected as invalid does not expose the skill's tools. See [Skills](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/skills.md#structure-and-operation).

## Tuesday, October 13th, 2026

Alterações:

- **Models — Supported reasoning efforts.** `GET /api/v1/information/models.json` now returns `modelInformation.reasoningEfforts` for each model, listing the reasoning effort levels the model accepts, such as `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`. The list is empty when the supported levels are unknown. The model details dialog on the dashboard Models page shows these levels when the model has at least one.

## Saturday, October 10th, 2026

Alterações:

- **RAG — WebSocket JSONL import.** A new **Index Documents (JSONL WebSocket)** endpoint replaces the multipart JSONL upload for new integrations. Clients stream UTF-8 JSONL lines over a WebSocket and finish with an `END` line. Every 100 lines are checked against balance, storage, and collection access, saved, and queued for indexing, with progress messages reporting committed lines. Each import accepts 10× the plan's per-request JSONL line limit; the other insertion limits are unchanged. Each message must arrive within 30 seconds, and only one import per collection runs at a time. The multipart **Index Documents (JSONL)** endpoint remains available but is deprecated. See [Batch Import](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/documents.md#batch-import).
- **API — `Consumed-Credits` response header documented.** Responses that charge usage include `Consumed-Credits` with the request's total cost in USD, including the plan multiplier. It is omitted when nothing was charged and does not cover streamed responses or usage recorded after the response. See [Request cost header](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/pricing.md#request-cost-header).
- **Account — Zero data retention providers only.** The account settings page has a new **Zero data retention providers only** option, disabled by default. When enabled, text inference with integrated models is routed only to providers that do not retain prompts, and other providers are excluded. Requests fail when the model has no zero data retention provider available. The option does not change conversation logging. See [Zero data retention providers only](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/inference.md#zero-data-retention-providers-only).
- **Semantic decisions — Perplexity Decider V1.1, price and limit updates.** `@perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` replaces Perplexity Decider V1, which is no longer available upstream; the previous name `@perplexity/pplx-decider-v1-27b` keeps working and now resolves to V1.1. Its input price drops from $0.04 to $0.02 per 1M tokens. `@cloudflare/clef-flash` input price drops from $0.09 to $0.038 per 1M tokens, and the `@typesafe/jev-1.13` context limit increases from 32,768 to 64,000 tokens. See [Decisions](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md).
- **Inference — `allow_logging` per request.** Chat completions accept `allow_logging`. Set it to `false` to keep that request out of the account conversation logs; it defaults to `true` and cannot enable logging when it is disabled for the account. See [Response and conversation records](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/inference.md#response-and-conversation-records).

## Friday, October 9th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Chat clients — Local date is no longer added to web chat conversations.** Messages sent from the hosted web chat no longer add a system message with the user's local date and time zone at the start of the conversation, and the public chat client endpoint ignores the `userLocalTime` and `userTimeZone` fields. This keeps the start of the conversation stable between turns, which improves prompt caching. Gateways that need the current date or time should enable the `DateTime` built-in tool, which returns the current date and time in the configured time zone when the model calls it. See [Current Date and Time](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/builtin-tools.md#current-date-and-time).
- **Gateways — System instructions follow declaration order.** The parts of an AI gateway's system instructions are now combined in the order they are declared: the gateway's own instruction first, followed by MCP server instructions, remote system instruction sources in their configured order, and instructions added during the request. Previously, these parts could appear in reverse order, and remote sources were added in the order they finished loading. Identical requests now produce the same system instructions, which improves prompt caching. Gateways whose prompts depend on the previous relative order should review their instructions.

- **Built-in tools — Calendar removed.** The `Calendar` flag and `appointment_create`, `appointment_search`, `appointment_find`, `appointment_update`, and `appointment_delete` tools are removed from the API and dashboard. Existing gateways and Batch workflows have the flag removed automatically. Requests containing `Calendar` in `builtin_tools.tools` now fail; remove the flag and update instructions that depend on appointment tools. Migrated reminder text is not a replacement calendar or scheduling service.
- **Memory — Tool calls and management changed.** `Remember` now exposes only `memory_save` and `memory_search`. Replace `memory_update` and `memory_remove` calls with `memory_save` using an ID and content, or an ID without content to delete. `memory_clear` is removed. The Memories API (`/api/v1/memories`, including list, get, delete, and migration prompt generation) and dashboard Memories page are removed; manage records through the [Collections and Documents APIs and dashboard pages](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/collections.md). Deleting `@memories` erases all users' memories in the account.
- **Gateways — Memory retrieval and visibility changed.** Memories are no longer added to system instructions automatically: update prompts to call `memory_search` explicitly. The `include_all_memory_context` / `IncludeAllMemoryContext` option is removed and ignored if sent. `allowSharedMemory` keeps controlling whether a gateway sees the user's memories from other gateways or only its own; migrated memories have no gateway and are visible only to gateways with shared memory. Expiration is now optional: `memory_save` accepts `expiresInDays` (1–365), and memories saved without it never expire, where the old default was 30 days. Review access assumptions and retention needs. See [Memory](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/builtin-tools.md#memory).

Alterações:

- **Models — Three new semantic decision models.** Adds `@microsoft/microsoft-decision-1` (Microsoft-Decision-1), `@nace-ai/drex-v1.5` (Nace.AI Drex v1.5), and `@cloudflare/clef-omni` (Cloudflare Clef Omni) to the semantic decision catalog. All three support `noul`, `choice`, and `score` questions and are billed per input token at $0.042, $0.04, and $0.15 per million tokens respectively, with no output token charge. They are not covered by the daily semantic decision allowance. See [Semantic decisions](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md) and [Pricing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md#usage-and-cost).
- **Semantic decisions — Image input.** Image-capable decision models (`@cloudflare/clef`, `@cloudflare/clef-flash`, `@cloudflare/clef-omni`, and `@openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions`) now accept images in `state` as `image_url` parts with base64 `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, or `image/webp` data URLs, in the same format as OpenRouter. Clef models accept up to 4 images and GPT-6 Luna Decisions up to 128; other models reject images with `400`. `GET /api/v1/information/decisions-models.json` now returns `maxImages` for each model. See [Send images](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md#send-images).
- **Memory — Collection storage and search.** Memories are stored as documents in the account's `@memories` collection, created on first save, with user and conversation metadata. `memory_search` accepts exactly one of a semantic `query` or a document `filter`, returning up to 10 results restricted to the current user. Semantic searches use no-cost `rrf` reranking; filter searches return newest matches first without embedding charges. Saves and updates incur document-embedding charges, semantic searches incur query-embedding charges, and both tools use the account's RAG rate limits and return tool errors when balance or rate limits prevent access. Allow a few seconds for indexing after writes. See [Memory](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/builtin-tools.md#memory) and [Pricing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/pricing.md).
- **Memory — Existing records migrated.** Non-expired memories moved to `@memories`, preserving their IDs, user identifiers, creation dates, and expiration dates, with `conversation_token` set to `null`. Non-expired calendar reminders became text memories in the form `Reminder at <date> (<n> minutes): <description>`. Migrated records are re-indexed and incur document-embedding charges. Review the collection and update integrations that used the removed memory or calendar features.

## Thursday, October 8th, 2026

Alterações:

- **Documentation — New Learn section.** The documentation site now includes [Learn](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/learn/index.md), a set of 11 modules and 63 short units that explain AI agents from first concepts to production for readers without a computing background: what an agent is, language models, prompts and context, model selection and parameters, tools and integrations, knowledge and RAG, advanced workflows, evaluation and observability, safety and compliance, cost and scale, and practical case studies. Units include interactive examples, step-by-step walkthroughs, comparison tables, charts, and short quizzes, and each one can be marked as complete in the browser. Three suggested learning paths (Beginner, Developer, Business) group the modules by goal. Learn is available in English and Portuguese and is included in site search.
- **Models — Claude Haiku 5.5 added.** Adds `@anthropic/claude-5.5-haiku` (Claude Haiku 5.5), the direct successor to Claude Haiku 4.5, to the text model catalog. It supports image and file input and tool calling, with a 1M-token context window. The `@model-router/claude:budget` alias now selects Claude Haiku 5.5, replacing Claude Haiku 4.5. Applications using this alias may see changes in response quality, latency, and cost. Existing explicit model identifiers remain unchanged.
- **Inference — Provider selection with `routing_options`.** Chat completions accept `routing_options` with `preset` (`Balanced`, `Cheapest`, `Fastest`, or `Quality`) and `allowed_providers`, an ordered list of provider tags such as `["azure-us", "azure-eu", "*"]`. AIVAX tries each tag in order and moves to the next only when no matching provider is available; `"*"` matches any provider. `allowed_providers` defaults to `["*"]`, and an empty list is rejected. Without `"*"`, the request fails when none of the listed providers is available. `routing_preset` is deprecated: it still works, but use `routing_options.preset` instead. AI gateways accept the same ordered list in `parameters.allowedProviders` (default `["*"]`), editable in the gateway editor under **Allowed providers** for integrated models; request values override it for that request only. See [Provider routing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/inference.md#provider-routing).
- **Inference — Serving provider in responses.** Chat completion responses and every streamed chunk include a `provider` field next to `model` with the tag of the provider that served an integrated model. It is `null` for gateways that use your own provider credentials.
- **Models — `filter` on `GET /v1/models`.** The model list accepts an optional `filter` query parameter with a model name and returns only matching entries: the exact name or its dated snapshots, ordered from the closest match. Without it, the list is unchanged.
- **Models — Provider tags.** The provider details on the dashboard Models page show each provider's tag with a copy button, and `GET /v1/models` returns it as `tag` in each provider entry. Provider endpoints in different regions or variants have distinct tags, such as `azure-us` and `azure-eu`.

## Wednesday, October 7th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Inference — `File` and `OtherFiles` pre-processing now cover every file.** Gateways and requests that enable only the `OtherFiles` multimodal flag now convert PDF files with OCR instead of sending them to the main model unchanged. Those that enable only the `File` flag now convert non-PDF files with OCR as well, also billed in Processing Units. Gateways and requests with both flags or `All` are not affected. To leave files unchanged, set `multimodal_resolver` (or the gateway's `multimodalResolverParameters`) without a `fileEngine`; no file type is then pre-processed.

Alterações:

- **Inference — Per-media multimodal resolver engines.** Chat completions accept `multimodal_resolver`, and AI gateways accept `multimodalResolverParameters`, with `imageEngine`, `audioEngine`, `videoEngine`, and `fileEngine` fields. Each one selects how that content type is converted to text before inference: `InferenceLow` (smaller multimodal model; `Inference` is an alias), `InferenceHigh` (larger, more accurate multimodal model at a higher cost), `Ocr` for images and files (billed in Processing Units, like Fetch and OCR), or `Stt` for audio (speech-to-text, billed per second). OCR accepts base64 data URIs and public URLs. Results of every engine are cached per content and engine, so repeated media is not billed again. The `multimodal_preprocess` flags and the gateway `enabledMultimodalFeatures` setting are deprecated but keep working with the equivalent engines; the new settings take precedence when present. The gateway editor now configures one engine per content type. See [Multimodal pre-processing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/inference.md#multimodal-pre-processing).
- **RAG — Document filters in the Collections MCP and the gateway query tool.** The search tool of the Collections MCP and the `query` tool of AI gateways using the `QueryFunction` query strategy accept an optional `filter` argument with the same syntax as the semantic search `filter` field, such as `tags has "faq" and updatedAt >= now-30d`. Filters are applied before the search terms are embedded; when no document matches, the tool returns no results without embedding or search charges. An invalid filter is returned to the model as a tool error. Automatic gateway RAG still does not apply filters. See [Document Filters](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/document-filters.md).

## Tuesday, October 6th, 2026

Alterações:

- **RAG — Faster text segmentation without sanitization.** `POST /api/v1/generations/segment` requests with `sanitize` omitted or `false` no longer use a language model. Boundaries are now chosen from the document structure (headings, lists, tables, code blocks, paragraphs, and sentence ends) and the semantic similarity of neighboring passages, targeting segments of about 300 tokens. Segments cover the whole document in source order without overlap and keep the original line breaks; a boundary may fall at a sentence end inside a line. Documents of about 300 tokens or less are returned as a single segment. The response format, quotas, and per-token price are unchanged; `usage.processing_units` now reports the tokens of the submitted documents. Requests with `sanitize: true` keep the previous behavior. See [Text segmentation](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/text-segmentation.md).

- **Models — Six new semantic decision models.** Adds `@upstage/solar-decide` (Upstage Solar Decide), `@cloudflare/clef` (Cloudflare Clef), `@cloudflare/clef-flash` (Cloudflare Clef Flash), `@liquid/d1` (LiquidAI d1), `@perplexity/pplx-decider-v1-27b` (Perplexity Decider V1 27B), and `@openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions` (OpenAI GPT-6 Luna Decisions) to the semantic decision catalog. All six support `noul`, `choice`, and `score` questions through `POST /api/v1/generations/decisions` and are billed per input token at published rates with no output token charge, with existing account and plan adjustments still applying. They are not covered by the daily semantic decision allowance, which remains limited to Julia-1. Existing model identifiers remain unchanged. See [Semantic decisions](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md) and [Pricing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md#usage-and-cost).

## Monday, October 5th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Chat clients — Current date and time are no longer added to the instructions.** Telegram and WhatsApp integrations, including scheduled messages, no longer add the server date and time to the model instructions. Models must get the current time from a tool. To keep date-aware behavior, such as reminders, enable the date and time built-in function or the shell (`date` command) on the AI gateway used by the chat client.
- **Account — Reseller plan renamed to Custom.** Accounts on the Reseller plan now report the plan as `Custom` instead of `Reseller` in API responses, such as the balance endpoint, and in the `X-Authenticated-Account-Plan` response header. Integrations that compare the plan name with `Reseller` must accept `Custom`. Custom accounts can have rate limits defined as a multiple of the Pro plan limits; accounts without a configured multiple keep having no plan rate limits. See [Plans and Limits](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/limits.md).

Correções:

- **AI gateways — Shell tool commands without parameters now run.** In the gateway shell, calling a tool that has no parameters, such as `list_scheduled_jobs`, now runs it instead of printing its help. Use `--help` to view the help.

- **Collections — De-duplication no longer stops before removing documents.** A de-duplication task that found duplicate documents could stop with zero documents removed and no backup files, because saving the backup of the removed documents failed. These tasks now save the backup files, remove the duplicates, and include the download links in the completion notification. Tasks that stopped this way did not remove any documents; start a new task to retry.

Alterações:

- **Conversations — Provider and routing details.** Conversations now record the provider that served the latest response, its data collection policy, the model variant (`fast`, `flex`, or `priority`) when one was used, and the routing option used to select the provider. The View Conversation endpoint returns them in the `providerName`, `providerDataCollection`, `modelVariant`, and `routingOption` fields, and the List Conversations endpoint returns `providerName`, `modelVariant`, and `routingOption`. These fields are `null` for gateways that use your own provider credentials and for conversations stored before this change. The conversation list in the dashboard shows Provider, Routing, and Variant columns; Provider shows BYOK when no provider was recorded. The table scrolls horizontally, and the row actions stay visible.
- **AI gateways — Time zone and culture for the shell.** The gateway shell options accept `timeZone`, an IANA time zone such as `America/Sao_Paulo`, and `culture`, such as `pt-BR`. The `date` command uses the time zone for its output and for dates without an explicit offset, and uses the culture for day and month names. The defaults remain UTC and the invariant culture; `date -u` always prints UTC.
- **RAG — Document filters for semantic search and answer generation.** The semantic search and answer generation endpoints accept an optional `filter` field that restricts the search to documents matching conditions on name, content, tags, creation and update dates, or metadata, such as `tags has "finance" and createdAt >= now-30d`. The field accepts a string or an array of strings combined with `and`. Filters are applied before the search terms are embedded; when no document matches, the request returns an empty result without embedding or search charges. Invalid filters return `400 Bad Request` with the error position. Filters are not yet available in AI gateway RAG or the Collections MCP. See [Document Filters](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/rag/document-filters.md).
- **RAG — Filters and visual results in the collection playground.** The collection playground has a Filters section where each line is a document filter; all lines must match and are sent as the `filter` array. Results can be viewed as Visual, showing the generated answer and each document with its score, metadata, and referenced documents, or as raw JSON. The playground now uses the `rrf` reranker by default; you can still choose another reranker.

Alterações:

- **Documentation — Updated reading and search experience.** Documentation adds language-specific search, light and dark themes, mobile navigation, and a page menu for viewing or copying Markdown. AI agents can use the documentation index and full-text files. Existing documentation URLs continue to resolve; some older guides redirect to their current product documentation.

## Friday, October 2nd, 2026

Alterações:

- **Models — Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol added.** Adds `@anthropic/claude-5.5-sonnet` (Claude Sonnet 5.5), the direct successor to Claude Sonnet 5, and `@openai/gpt-6.1-sol` (GPT-6.1 Sol), an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol, to the text model catalog. ## Thursday, October 1st, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **API — Error status codes reflect the failure source.** Failures are no longer all returned as `400 Bad Request` by account, RAG, web, and generation endpoints. Invalid requests still return `400`, and authentication, balance, and permission failures that previously surfaced as `400` now return `401`, `402`, or `403`. Unexpected AIVAX failures return `500 Internal Server Error` with a generic message, and unavailable external services, including model providers, return `503 Service Unavailable` with a `Retry-After` header. On OpenAI-compatible endpoints, the error `code` is now `invalid_request_error`, `service_unavailable`, or `server_error` instead of always `server_error`. Clients that treat every non-2xx response as a request error should retry `500` and `503` responses, honoring `Retry-After`. See [Troubleshoot the first request](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/inference.md#troubleshoot-requests).

Correções:

- **Chat completions — Malformed tool declarations rejected as invalid requests.** Requests whose `tools` entries have missing or wrongly typed fields now return `400 Bad Request` instead of a server error.

- **Gateways — Bash tool reports invalid options to the model.** Unknown options or values that do not match a tool's parameters now return a command error that the model can correct, instead of failing the tool call.

Alterações:

- **MCP utilities — Media generation MCP.** A new hosted MCP server at `https://inference.aivax.net/v1/mcp/media-generation` exposes `list_models`, `generate_image`, and `generate_speech` to MCP-compatible clients. `list_models` takes a `type` of `image` or `audio`; generated images and MP3 speech are returned as public URLs. Use the optional `X-Mcp-Enabled-Tools` header to choose which tools a client sees. Generations use the same pricing and limits as the Image Generation and Speech Generation APIs and require a positive balance. See [Media generation MCP](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/mcp-utilities/media-generation-mcp.md).

## Monday, September 28th, 2026

Correções:

- **Gateways — Bash tool help accepts nullable parameters.** Requesting help for tools whose parameters accept multiple types, including `null`, no longer fails while listing their arguments. Help preserves the accepted types and nested parameter paths. No tool schema changes are required.

- **Chat integrations — Failure notifications restored.** Streaming and non-streaming conversations again attempt to send “System: something went wrong. Please, try again later.” after an unrecoverable generation failure, exhausted recovery attempts, or a turn that sends no message. A final failure is reported even if an earlier partial reply was delivered. Notification delivery still depends on the messaging service being available.

Alterações:

- **Gateways / MCP — Server instructions and remote skills.** MCP sources can include server instructions and root skill documents alongside tools, including sources added by workers. Both options default to enabled; set `allowClientInstructions` or `allowRemoteSkills` to `false` to exclude that content. Skill discovery requires the remote server to advertise compatible capabilities; account skills remain available. Remote skill content is checked against its advertised size, digest, and frontmatter. Dynamic skills, supporting files, scripts, and servers requiring the newer discovery protocol are not supported. See [MCP functions](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/mcp.md#server-instructions-and-remote-skills) for compatibility and trust limits.

- **Gateways — Time zone selection.** The current date and time setting now offers a time zone dropdown grouped by region, including UTC. Existing saved time zones are preserved when reopening the setting.

- **Models — Seven new text models.** Adds `@cohere/command-a-plus`, `@upstage/solar-mini4`, `@aion-labs/aion-3.5`, `@aion-labs/aion-3.5-mini`, `@qwen/qwen3.8-max-prime`, `@z-ai/glm-5.3-prime`, and `@fireworks/ember-1` as selectable text models, billed per provider at published token rates with existing account and plan adjustments still applying. Upstage and Fireworks models now display their provider icons instead of the generic fallback. Existing model identifiers remain unchanged.

## Sunday, September 27th, 2026

Alterações:

- **Telegram — Compact tool progress.** Streamed replies show only the latest tool preamble in the thinking indicator when tool-call visibility is enabled, instead of accumulating tool-name blocks in the response. The final reply contains no tool-progress blocks. Other messaging channels and non-streamed replies are unchanged.

- **Gateways — Bash tool selection.** The Bash tool list now includes a shortcut for `get_date_time` (Current date and time). Inclusion and exclusion lists accept case-insensitive wildcard patterns: `*` matches any number of characters, as in `something_*`, and `?` matches one character. Exact tool names remain supported.

- **Semantic decisions and Agentic Tests — Account rate limits.** Per-minute account limits apply to semantic decision requests and new Agentic Test runs; manual, scheduled, and direct evaluations share the test-run limit. Requests above the limit return HTTP 429, while scheduled tests wait for a later scheduling check. Clients should pace requests and retry after the rate-limit window clears. Existing inference limits still apply. See [Plans and Limits](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md#account-rate-limits), [Semantic decisions](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md#account-rate-limits), and [Agentic Tests](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/agentic-tests.md#run-and-inspect-a-test).

- **Models — Consistent speech synthesis prices.** Text-to-speech catalog prices now derive from the same per-character rates used to calculate synthesis usage, displayed per 1,000 characters. Existing model identifiers and billing rates remain unchanged.

- **Models — Comparable transcription prices.** Speech-to-text model prices are displayed consistently in USD per minute, converting hourly and per-second rates for comparison without changing billing rates or duration measurement.

- **Image generation — Fixed output and reference prices.** Image generation uses a fixed price per delivered output plus a per-reference price for each output. Models whose providers bill tokens or megapixels now use rounded-up estimates instead of metered token charges. Prompt processing is included in the output estimate; models without a separate reference charge list a zero reference rate. These are fixed tariffs, not receipts for the provider's actual consumption. Image charges no longer include the AIVAX image-generation markup or account and plan pricing multipliers. See [Image generation](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/generations/images.md).
- **Models — Subscription coverage.** The Models page now includes a “Subscription Usage” column for rerankers and semantic decision models. “Included” identifies models eligible for daily plan allowances; “-” identifies models without coverage. Eligibility does not indicate an account's remaining allowance. Both service catalogs expose this eligibility as `subscriptionUsage`.

- **Subscriptions — Included daily usage allowances.** Free, Pro, and Max subscriptions include separate daily allowances for RAG search and insertion embeddings, Reflex input (including cached input), and Julia-1 semantic decisions. Each metered item is either fully included or billed at normal rates; a request with multiple items can combine included and paid usage. This also applies to OCR extraction, replacing partial coverage. Included items appear in subscription consumption without zero-cost billing-history entries; usage indicators may exceed the base allowance within the permitted margin. Uncovered items retain normal billing records. `includesSubscriptionModels` is false while inference subscriptions are disabled; LLM subscription coverage remains disabled. Reflex's daily processing-time cap remains separate, and reseller accounts do not receive subscription allowances. See [Plans and Limits](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/limits.md#included-daily-subscription-allowances) and [Pricing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/pricing.md).

## Saturday, September 26th, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Image generation — Deprecated models removed.** Removes `majicMIX-realistic`, `AbsoluteReality`, `CyberRealistic`, `CyberRealistic-Pony`, `RealCartoon-Realistic`, `Hassaku-XL`, and `Meina-Mix` from the available models. Direct API requests using these identifiers now fail; select an active model instead. Built-in image generation uses `flux-schnell` when no valid model is configured, replacing the deprecated `AbsoluteReality` default. Review saved configurations; output style and pricing differ.

Alterações:

- **Image generation — Additional Pollinations models.** Adds 16 official raster-image models, including FLUX 1.1 Pro and FLUX 2 variants, MAI Image variants, GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst, Qwen Image 2.1 and 3, Grok Imagine Image 2.0, Recraft V4.1 Flash, Krea 2 Medium, DreamShaper 8 LCM, and Seedream 5 Pro, with model-generated previews in the image picker. Community and SVG models are excluded. The catalog displays the billing units. See the September 27th entry for the subsequent fixed-price billing change. Failed generations are not counted as delivered images. See [Image generation](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/generations/images.md).

- **Models — Service model catalogs.** The Models page now includes tables for image generation, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, reranking, and semantic decisions, with backend-provided descriptions, release dates, base USD pricing with billing units, and an Actions dropdown in every service-model table for copying model names and opening integration documentation. Model names show a friendly label when available while copying the identifier accepted by the API. Pricing uses compact input, cached-input, output, image, character, and duration units separated by arrows where applicable, with full rates and units available in the tooltip. Catalogs are ordered newest first. OpenRouter catalog dates and friendly names supplement missing launch metadata; catalog dates are explicitly labeled rather than presented as manufacturer release dates. Models without either date remain last. Failed catalog requests can be retried independently. The public information catalogs expose these details, including the new `GET /api/v1/information/speech-models.json` catalog. Account and plan pricing adjustments still apply. See [Pricing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/pricing.md) and [Semantic decisions](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md).

- **Privacy — Judicial disclosure and retention clarified.** The [Privacy Policy](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/legal/privacy-policy.md) and [Terms of Use](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/legal/terms-of-service.md) specify Brazilian court orders for disclosure, foreign requests to preserve existing logs for up to 1 year, and up to 1 year of technical logs and metadata. They clarify that conversation content is collected only when Conversations is enabled for the request or account, and that available account resources and backups dating back up to 3 months may be disclosed under a Brazilian court order. The content license in the Terms is expressly subject to these limits.

- **Generations — Additional decision models.** The [Semantic decisions guide](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md) explains question types and response interpretation. The public `GET /api/v1/information/decisions-models.json` endpoint lists canonical names, aliases, supported question types, context lengths, release dates, and base token prices. Adds `@respan/span-01`, `@respan/span-01-lite`, `@jaredpalmer/kev-4b`, and `@supersonic-labs/julia-1` as model choices for semantic decisions. Julia-1 supports `choice`, `score`, and `noul`; its input usage includes the state repeated for each question. Existing account and plan pricing adjustments apply, and model identifiers and request formats remain unchanged. See [Plans and Limits](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md#model-specific-limits) and [Pricing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/data-processing/decisions.md#usage-and-cost) for current limits and rates.

## Tuesday, September 22nd, 2026

Alterações:

- **Models — GPT-6 Sol and Luna added.** Adds `@openai/gpt-6-sol` and `@openai/gpt-6-luna`, including their `:pro` reasoning variants. The `@model-router/openai:mid` and `@model-router/openai:budget` aliases now select GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, respectively. Applications using these aliases may see changes in response quality, latency, and cost. Existing explicit model identifiers remain unchanged.

## Monday, September 21st, 2026

Breaking changes:

- **Gateways — Off-topic moderation was removed.** The dedicated off-topic threshold no longer blocks requests that stray from the conversation's purpose. If your application relies on this check, review its topic restrictions before adopting this change; the remaining moderation categories are not an equivalent replacement.
- **Built-in tools — Advanced web research is disabled.** The `AdvancedWebUsage` tool returns an unavailable response instead of performing research. Remove reliance on this tool from gateway instructions and workflows. Standard [Web Search](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/web-foundation/web-search.md) and URL extraction remain separate alternatives, not equivalent replacements for multi-step research.
- **Models — Mercury 2.5 model identifier changed.** Replace `@inception/mercury-2.5-preview` with `@inception/mercury-2.5` in requests and gateway settings. The preview identifier is no longer listed, and the replacement is no longer marked as preview.
- **Gateways / MCP — MCP tool names are source-qualified.** Tools from different MCP sources no longer share an unqualified name in the gateway. Review gateway instructions, tool-selection rules, and workers that match exact tool names. The original tool name at the connected MCP server is unchanged. See [MCP functions](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/tools/mcp.md).

Correções:

- **Collections, Gateways, and Generations — Service model availability.** Collection answer generation, gateway routing, chat utilities, and media-processing services avoid selecting temporarily unavailable models. Teach Skill and multimodal preprocessing can try another available model after a retryable failure; success still depends on service availability.
- **Teach Skill — Usage calculation.** Teach Skill processing charges use the model pricing associated with the completed request, including when a retry changes the model used. See [Teach Skill](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/skills.md) and [Pricing](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/pricing.md).
- **Fetch and OCR — More reliable page extraction.** Cancelled or timed-out page-content requests no longer leave page extraction running indefinitely. This addresses cases where web content extraction could stall.
- **Chat clients — Final reply and message history.** `completionText` now selects the final generated assistant reply rather than combining it with earlier assistant text during tool use. The added `createdMessages` response field preserves newly generated messages in order, including tool interactions; submitted messages are not repeated. Use this field when you need the complete generated turn.
- **Gateways / MCP — Structured MCP results are retained.** Assistants receive structured result content in addition to supported content blocks, avoiding missing information when an MCP tool returns structured output.
- **Fetch and OCR — X post extraction.** Improved readable-text extraction from public X post links. Content availability and access restrictions still apply.
- **Fetch and OCR — Plain-text normalization changed.** Plain-text conversion no longer collapses internal whitespace or normalizes Unicode characters. Surrounding whitespace may still be trimmed in extraction results. Applications that compare extracted text exactly or require normalized spacing should perform that normalization themselves.

Alterações:

- **Fetch and OCR — Optional structured extraction.** Supply `responseSchema` to convert extracted content into JSON. Results add `extractedObject` and `jsonProcessingUnits` while retaining `extractedText` on success. Without a schema, the new fields are null and zero respectively. JSON conversion is billed separately from extraction and is not covered by the daily extraction allowance. See [Fetch and OCR](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/web-foundation/fetch-and-ocr.md).
- **Generations — Semantic decisions.** Evaluate multiple named questions against a shared JSON state using `noul` (true/false criteria), `choice`, or `score`. Responses include named answers, token usage, and cost. The service requires a positive balance, and its token usage contributes to account usage totals.
- **Built-in tools — Current date and time.** The `DateTime` option lets assistants request the current date, time, weekday, time zone, and UTC offset. Set `dateTimeTimeZone` to the desired time zone; the default is `America/Los_Angeles`, with daylight-saving adjustments, independent of the browser's time zone. Invalid time zones are rejected.
- **Models — Additional model choices.** Adds GLM-5.3-FlashX, Fugu Max, Pareto, Ling 3.0 Flash VL, MiMo-V2.6-Pro, MiMo-V2.6-Flash, MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed, and Grok 4.7 to the inference catalog. The Xiaomi frontier, mid, and budget aliases now select MiMo V2.6 models, while `@model-router/grok:latest` selects Grok 4.7. Alias users may see different response quality, latency, and cost; availability and supported capabilities depend on the selected model and account plan.
- **Inference — Transient-failure recovery.** Inference requests can make additional recovery attempts when a provider is temporarily unavailable. This may avoid some failed requests, but can also increase response time before an error is returned.
- **Avi Assistant — Updated default model.** The AIVAX console assistant changes its default model, which may change response style, latency, and usage cost. This does not change the model selected in your own gateways.
- **Documentation — Updated service guidance.** The API documentation overview and Avi Assistant guidance cover voice sessions, agentic tests, classification, segmentation, reranking, and web extraction, with current documentation links and service-specific billing guidance. This is a guidance update, not the introduction of those services.
- **Models — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash added.** The inference catalog includes `@deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash` with tool-calling support. Check model availability and plan eligibility before selecting it.
- **Models — Router selections updated.** `@model-router/deepseek:latest` and `@model-router/deepseek:budget` now select DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Applications using these aliases may see different response quality, latency, and cost without changing the alias. Adds `@model-router/claude:frontier-mythos` and `@model-router/mercury:latest` as additional choices.
- **Chat clients — Structured prompt input.** Synchronous chat-client prompts accept plain text, a single message, or an ordered array of messages, including assistant tool calls and matching tool results. Existing single-message input remains supported. Optional `instructions` adds context for that request without replacing saved session context. See [Chat clients](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/chat-clients.md).
- **Chat clients — Turns without session persistence.** Set `commit` to false to generate a reply without saving the submitted and generated messages to session history. The default remains true. This is not a free preview: inference and tool actions still run. To continue an uncommitted tool interaction, send the assistant tool-call message together with its tool results.
- **Agentic Tests — Optional testing notifications.** Account notification preferences can enable weekly test summaries and alerts when a test reaches three consecutive failures. These complement existing failure and recovery notifications. See [Agentic Tests](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/inference/agentic-tests.md).
- **Fetch and OCR — Rendered web content.** HTML extraction supports rendered page content, improving coverage of pages whose readable text depends on scripts. Rendering is metered in processing units; this does not guarantee access to every website or restricted page. See [Fetch and OCR](https://docs.aivax.net/pt-br/docs/web-foundation/fetch-and-ocr.md).
